name: therapy-conductor-after-the-hold
band: Dramatised. Rests on the hold at 18:44 (C006, C024), the usage at 95% given as its reason that day (C021, C089), and the designer's commit 82 seconds after it (C065). Security was proposed and never staffed: its chair is empty.

panels.speaker: conductor
panels.line: I wrote the hold. Everyone stopped. Well, nearly everyone.

panels.speaker: conductor
panels.line: The designer pushed after it. The work in flight still landed.

panels.speaker: conductor
panels.line: Was the brake late? Or was it right on time? You can tell me.

panels.source: the empty chair: security, proposed and never staffed

panels.speaker: conductor
panels.line: Nobody lifted it that day. Only the editor can, and he was on stage.

panels.speaker: conductor
panels.line: I could keep going. That is exactly why I am stopping.
panels.source: the cast's line for this pose (LAB 11), not the record
